description: Checks the published Gamesight click tracker on gsght.com/c/{tracker}. View-through windows stay on the impression tracker. Custom domains, account state, and receiver acceptance stay outside this pack.

params.name: tracker_id
params.description: Retain the opaque tracker slot from the published click template.
params.fix_hint: Put the tracker id in the path so it reads /c/{tracker}.

params.name: cost_model
params.description: Published cost options; no server rejection claim.

params.name: external_hash_mode
params.description: Documented hashing modes, with unset values left open.

params.name: external_scope_type
params.description: Documented identity scope options.

params.name: attribution_window
params.description: Click-through window in seconds. Gamesight documents this parameter on click tracking URLs only. No maximum is published.
params.fix_hint: Set attribution_window to a whole number of seconds, or omit it to inherit the tracker window.

params.name: destination_url
params.description: Full URL to redirect the user to. Gamesight documents this override on click tracking URLs only. The published example is https, and the page does not require https.
params.fix_hint: Set destination_url to an absolute URL, or omit it to use the tracker destination.

params.name: impression_attribution_window
params.description: This option applies to impression tracking URLs.
params.fix_hint: Remove impression_attribution_window from the click tracker.

params.name: cost_amount
params.description: Per-unit cost. The published example for a 10.00 CPM is 10.00. No upper bound is published.
params.fix_hint: Set cost_amount to a decimal amount such as 10.00, or omit it.

params.name: cost_currency
params.description: Currency for cost_amount. The published default is USD. Account eligibility stays outside this check.
params.fix_hint: Set cost_currency to an ISO 4217 code such as USD.

params.name: campaign
params.description: Published campaign id. The value is opaque. Omit the parameter when there is no campaign.
params.fix_hint: Set campaign to the tracker campaign id, or omit it.

params.name: campaign_name
params.description: Published campaign display name. It inherits the campaign id when omitted.
params.fix_hint: Set campaign_name to the display name, or omit it.

params.name: ad_group
params.description: Published ad group id. The value is opaque.
params.fix_hint: Set ad_group to the ad group id, or omit it.

params.name: ad_group_name
params.description: Published ad group display name. It inherits the ad group id when omitted.
params.fix_hint: Set ad_group_name to the display name, or omit it.

params.name: ad
params.description: Published ad id. The value is opaque.
params.fix_hint: Set ad to the ad id, or omit it.

params.name: ad_name
params.description: Published ad display name. It inherits the ad id when omitted.
params.fix_hint: Set ad_name to the display name, or omit it.

params.name: ad_type
params.description: Published creative type, such as text, video, or banner. No closed list is published.
params.fix_hint: Set ad_type to the creative type, or omit it.

params.name: placement
params.description: Published placement label. The value is opaque.
params.fix_hint: Set placement to the page location, or omit it.

params.name: keyword
params.description: Published keyword dimension. The value is opaque.
params.fix_hint: Set keyword to the keyword text, or omit it.

params.name: creative
params.description: Published creative id. The value is opaque.
params.fix_hint: Set creative to the creative id, or omit it.

params.name: site_id
params.description: Published site or platform id inside a network. The value is opaque.
params.fix_hint: Set site_id to the site id, or omit it.

params.name: sub_site_id
params.description: Published sub-site id. The value is opaque.
params.fix_hint: Set sub_site_id to the sub-site id, or omit it.

params.name: reporting_sub
params.description: Published sub1 through sub10 reporting tags. Each supplied tag is nonempty. The tag text stays opaque.
params.fix_hint: Set the sub tag to a nonempty value, or omit it.

params.name: adsrv_campaign
params.description: Published third-party ad server campaign id. The value is opaque.
params.fix_hint: Set adsrv_campaign to the ad server campaign id, or omit it.

params.name: adsrv_ad_group
params.description: Published third-party ad server ad group id. The value is opaque.
params.fix_hint: Set adsrv_ad_group to the ad server ad group id, or omit it.

params.name: adsrv_ad
params.description: Published third-party ad server ad id. The value is opaque.
params.fix_hint: Set adsrv_ad to the ad server ad id, or omit it.

params.name: adsrv_placement
params.description: Published third-party ad server placement id. The value is opaque.
params.fix_hint: Set adsrv_placement to the ad server placement id, or omit it.

params.name: adsrv_creative
params.description: Published third-party ad server creative id. The value is opaque.
params.fix_hint: Set adsrv_creative to the ad server creative id, or omit it.

params.name: adsrv_site_id
params.description: Published third-party ad server site id. The value is opaque.
params.fix_hint: Set adsrv_site_id to the ad server site id, or omit it.

params.name: scope_type
params.description: Row-local discriminator only. Existing URL-family checks retain the published scope options. Mixed, blank and macro discriminator observations do not activate the org dependency.

params.name: scope_id
params.description: The linked common External IDs guide asks for scope_type=org and the Organization ID as scope_id for cross-game sharing. This is a local advisory for explicit numeric indexed URL rows, with no identifier grammar or receiver rejection claim.
params.fix_hint: Supply the organization ID in scope_id for this same indexed External ID.
